<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class Base162Review {
    public function needBase($one, $two): string { echo "bad-base|"; return "base"; }
}
$owner162Review = new class extends Base162Review {
    public function needOwn($one, $two): string { echo "bad-own|"; return "own"; }
    public function wrongOwn(): string { echo "return|"; return 7; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "owner-drop|"; }
};
$own162Review = $owner162Review->needOwn(...);
$base162Review = $owner162Review->needBase(...);
$wrong162Review = $owner162Review->wrongOwn(...);
unset($owner162Review);
echo "before|";
try {
    $own162Review(1);
} catch (ArgumentCountError $caught162Review) {
    echo $caught162Review->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Review->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $base162Review(1);
} catch (ArgumentCountError $caught162Review) {
    echo $caught162Review->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Review->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $wrong162Review();
} catch (TypeError $caught162Review) {
    echo $caught162Review->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Review->getLine(), "|";
}
unset($own162Review, $base162Review, $wrong162Review);
echo "after";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$owner162Invoke = new class {
    public static function need(int $head, $tail): string { echo "bad-body|"; return "bad"; }
    public static function wrong(): string { echo "return|"; return 7; }
    public static function neverReturn(): never {
        echo "never|";
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "static-drop|"; }
};
$need162Invoke = $owner162Invoke::need(...);
$wrong162Invoke = $owner162Invoke::wrong(...);
$never162Invoke = $owner162Invoke::neverReturn(...);
unset($owner162Invoke);
try {
    $need162Invoke->__invoke(1);
} catch (ArgumentCountError $caught162Invoke) {
    echo $caught162Invoke->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Invoke->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $need162Invoke->__invoke("bad", tail: 2);
} catch (TypeError $caught162Invoke) {
    echo $caught162Invoke->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Invoke->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $wrong162Invoke->__invoke();
} catch (TypeError $caught162Invoke) {
    echo $caught162Invoke->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Invoke->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $never162Invoke->__invoke();
} catch (TypeError $caught162Invoke) {
    echo $caught162Invoke->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Invoke->getLine(), "|";
}
echo "after";

<?php
$source162Author = new class {
    public static function requiredStatic($first, $last) {
        echo "bad-body|";
        return 99;
    }
};
$captured162Author = $source162Author::requiredStatic(...);
function effect162Author($label) {
    echo $label, "|";
    return 7;
}
try {
    $captured162Author(effect162Author("positional"));
} catch (ArgumentCountError $caught162Author) {
    echo $caught162Author->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Author->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $captured162Author(last: effect162Author("named"));
} catch (ArgumentCountError $caught162Author) {
    echo $caught162Author->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Author->getLine(), "|";
}
echo "after";

<?php
$source162Eval = 'namespace Captured162Author;
function make162Author() {
    return new class {
        static function WrongReturn162Author(): int {
            echo "wrong-body|";
            return [];
        }
        static function MissingReturn162Author(): int {
            echo "missing-body|";
        }
        static function NeverReturn162Author(): never {
            echo "never-body|";
        }
    };
}';
eval($source162Eval);
$object162Eval = Captured162Author\make162Author();
$wrong162Eval = $object162Eval::WrongReturn162Author(...);
$missing162Eval = $object162Eval::MissingReturn162Author(...);
$never162Eval = $object162Eval::NeverReturn162Author(...);
try {
    $wrong162Eval();
} catch (TypeError $caught162Eval) {
    echo $caught162Eval->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Eval->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $missing162Eval();
} catch (TypeError $caught162Eval) {
    echo $caught162Eval->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Eval->getLine(), "|";
}
try {
    $never162Eval();
} catch (TypeError $caught162Eval) {
    echo $caught162Eval->getMessage(), "|", $caught162Eval->getLine(), "|";
}
echo "after";
